tagline: Zeiss Ikon旁轴相机，1951 年发布
description: Zeiss Ikon于1951年推出的旁轴相机。快门速度Novar 4.5/105 mm lens in a Prontor-S shutter Novar 3.5/105 mm lens in a Prontor-S shutter Tessar 3.5/105 mm lens in a Synchro-Compur shutter。使用6 x 9 cm on 120 type rollfilm。

specs.快门: Novar 4.5/105 mm lens in a Prontor-S shutter Novar 3.5/105 mm lens in a Prontor-S shutter Tessar 3.5/105 mm lens in a Synchro-Compur shutter
specs.闪光灯: Socket on shutter, X-synchronisation, Synchro-Compur also M-synchronisation
specs.英文简介: The 524/2 is a folding camera in the Ikonta line, produced by the German company Zeiss Ikon.
